# BPFCo project instructions

Follow the root `AGENTS.md` and `Brain/Executive/BPFCo_BUILD_CONTRACT.md`.

This is an existing system. Inspect before modifying.
Continue the current architecture; do not rebuild it.

Priority:
1. Preserve BPFCoBrain.
2. Extend the Super Dashboard.
3. Extend the Presence/Avatar layer.
4. Keep local/offline operation and human approval gates.
5. Use large dependencies only when Wi-Fi is available.
